2. Description of Service

Kaziranga Voice is an advocacy application designed to facilitate communication with the Director of Kaziranga National Park regarding conservation and land protection concerns. The Application allows users to:

  • Compose and send emails to the Director of Kaziranga National Park
  • Create and document offline letters through photography
  • Track the collective number of advocacy messages sent
